page.overview:
Who is Rusty Manifold?

Jounalist|appear=Cars 2 (name only) Cars 3 (physical appearence)}}

Rusty Manifold is a character in Cars 2 and Cars 3.

In Cars 2, his name is seen on a newspaper during The Mel Dorado Show. He would report on the disappearance of Miles Axlerod.

Rusty Manifold would make his physical appearance during the archive recording of the 1954 Fireball Beach race. He was one of the many competitors the Hudson Hornet would pass on track. Eventually Rusty and several other racers would come to a stop due to the Hudson Hornet wrecking out.
